motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council request the City Attorney, in consultation with the Bureau of Sanitation, prepare and present an ordinance amending the Low Impact Development (LID) Ordinance to establish an administrative release pathway for projects in the 500 to 2,499 square foot impervious area range currently pending under the prior LID Ordinance (Ordinance No. 183833), allowing such projects to be released from these LID compliance requirements and instead subject to the applicability thresholds of the current ordinance (Ordinance No. 188125). title: Low Impact Development (LID) Ordinance / Administrative Release Pathway
